description:
## [1.27.0](https://github.com/totsiaw/proxma-patches/compare/1.26.9...1.27.0) (2026-10-23)

### New Features

* **mytelenor:** auto-claim daily streak MBs and quiz rewards ([49ddd6c](https://github.com/totsiaw/proxma-patches/commit/49ddd6caca9f537cbe9f53195c65b341de86fea4))

patches.name: Bypass PairIP license check
patches.description: Disables Google PairIP's license/installer check (com.pairip.licensecheck) so a re-signed build runs on a real device instead of being redirected to the Play Store and killed. No-ops the LicenseContentProvider entry point and LicenseClient.initializeLicenseCheck().

patches.name: Unlock premium (remove ads)
patches.description: Unlocks Investify premium — forces the backend `no_ads` entitlement getter to report true in both the model and its Realm proxy, so the app treats the account as ad-free without any purchase. Ad SDK loads are gated on this flag app-wide.

patches.name: Bypass anti-tamper (foodpanda)
patches.description: Bypasses foodpanda's DeliveryHero MAS integrity block — forces the master security gate (`w9u.a`) to report the device/app as trusted AND short-circuits the enforcement orchestrator that launches the block screen, so re-signed / sideloaded builds no longer hit the "This device or application is not supported" BlockedActivity.

patches.name: Force dark mode
patches.description: Rewrites foodpanda's baked-in Bento color constants to dark equivalents so the app renders a real dark theme. The app ships no dark palette — R8 merged its light and dark token sets into one identical set of dex constants — so theme, force-dark and values-night changes have no effect. Brand colors are left untouched.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes foodpanda's adtech banner ads (all placements: order-tracking, home, discovery, reels) and the forced PandaMart "CrossSell" popup, and suppresses the forced in-app review prompt (DeliveryHero InAppRatingActivity).

patches.name: Unlock premium (foodpanda)
patches.description: Unlocks foodpanda pandapro — forces every `isSubscribed()` check (status instanceof UserSubscriptionStatus.Subscribed) to report subscribed and forces Subscribed.hasBenefits() true, so the app's pro state, UI and entitlement gates unlock. Server-enforced benefits (free delivery, vouchers) still require a real subscription.

patches.name: Auto check-in & claim daily reward
patches.description: Claims today's daily check-in and today's Daily Rewards rung on their own, once a day, a few seconds after the app has loaded them — no ad and nothing to tap. The missed-days restore and the day-10/20/30 milestone claim are untouched.

patches.name: Background daily check-in worker
patches.description: Runs the Simosa daily check-in from a 24-hour WorkManager job that this patch adds to the app, with two-tier token auth, stale-token retry, a per-account day latch and a status notification.

patches.name: Bypass signature verification
patches.description: Disables Simosa's anti-tamper signature check so a re-signed APK launches normally instead of stalling on the splash / "version is not correct" dialog.

patches.name: Dark theme (black background)
patches.description: Makes Simosa a dark app: screens, sheets, dialogs and menus use the dark palette (near-black background, light text) instead of the light one, including on Android 12+ where the app would otherwise take a light colour scheme from the wallpaper. The app's own red/orange branding and its white cards are left alone so text on them stays readable.

patches.name: Remove Shop, Social+ and Lifestyle tabs
patches.description: Removes the Shop, Social+ and Lifestyle tabs from the bottom bar, leaving Home and Account (plus any optional tab this build enables). Nothing is deleted: those screens still exist and still open if the app routes to them (a deep link, a tile, a notification) — they just no longer take a tab.

patches.name: Remove ads & tracking
patches.description: Removes every ad (interstitial, banner, daily-reward) and every tracker (Mixpanel, Firebase, Facebook, AppsFlyer) — app events, network sends, ad-SDK requests (Google Ads / AppLovin / AnyMind / Prebid), SDK auto-collection, and the ipify IP leak. The app then phones home only to its own Jazz API.

patches.name: Remove daily check-in ads
patches.description: Removes the SocialPlus daily check-in / in-feed ads (FeedAdsManager banner + native loaders) and the day-10/20/30 milestone-claim RewardedAd (the award is still granted, just with no ad). Separate from "Remove ads & tracking" to keep that patch Morphe-Manager-safe; enable this one when patching with the desktop CLI.

patches.name: Force dark mode
patches.description: Forces OLX into dark (night) mode regardless of the system theme, using the app's built-in -night resources via UiModeManager.setApplicationNightMode at startup.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes native feed ads (Google GMA), the full-height ad slot, the "Buy with Delivery" promo section (bar, cards and View all), the three item-page banner slots, and the home-screen banner slots from OLX. Pinned to the 18.8.0 build (matches that build's obfuscated feed, item-page and home classes).

patches.name: Remove Elite promotions
patches.description: Removes the promoted Elite seller cards and the buyer-matchmaking recommendation slot from OLX India's listing feed — OLX's own paid placements, which the ad-removal patch does not cover.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes ads from OLX India by disabling the in-house Baxter ad SDK at its own enable predicate (com.naspers.advertising.baxterandroid.f.d()). Every ad path — native feed, full-page, interstitial, swipe, adpv and the ad view itself — already checks this predicate, so disabling it stops the ad requests rather than just hiding the boxes.

patches.name: Bypass license verification
patches.description: Bypasses Google Play's PairIP license check so a re-signed Safar build runs instead of being blocked by the "Get this app from Play" paywall or a "Something went wrong" dialog.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes Safar's AdMob banner, interstitial and app-open ads by stubbing the react-native-google-mobile-ads load funnels (no ad is requested, so none renders). User-initiated rewarded ads are left working.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes every AdMob ad — the interstitial (rerouted to its onAdFailedToLoad branch so the proxy-apply action still runs, but no ad loads or shows) and the on-screen banner (load skipped). No feature is lost.

patches.name: Block update prompt
patches.description: Forces Remote Config to report latest_version_name=1.0.3 and android_latest_build=34, matching the installed version so the force-update dialog never appears.

patches.name: Bypass login
patches.description: Restores a signed-in user from an embedded assets/sw_cred.json (pre-formatted Firebase credential file) into SharedPreferences before FirebaseAuth initialises, so the constructor picks up the stored user. Falls back to anonymous sign-in (H3/h + zzacq.zza) if the asset is missing. Also short-circuits the Google sign-in provider flow (O5/p pswitch_5) to reuse the current user.

patches.name: Unlock pass
patches.description: Unlocks paid content (Monthly Pass: lessons, tutor, reports) by forging pass-expiry and active fields in Firestore document maps the app reads. Also forces latest_version_name and android_latest_build to installed values when present in a Firestore doc, blocking the update prompt via the Firestore path.

patches.name: Auto-claim daily rewards
patches.description: Claims daily streak MBs and Answer & Win quiz rewards automatically via a background WorkManager job scheduled from MainActivity.

patches.name: Block trackers
patches.description: Stops the Insider, TikTok Business SDK and Mixpanel Session Replay trackers from initializing (event/attribution/session-replay tracking never starts). Leaves AWS Amplify, Firebase core/RemoteConfig/FCM and Google Ads init untouched so app data, push and the remote ad-config the ads patch relies on keep working.

patches.name: Block trackers (manifest flags)
patches.description: Disables Firebase Analytics + Google advertiser-id auto-collection and the Facebook SDK's auto app-events / advertiser-id / auto-init via AndroidManifest <meta-data> flags — the SDK-side auto-collection that no bytecode init-stub can reach. Leaves Firebase core (FCM push, RemoteConfig) and the Facebook ContentProvider intact. Separate from the bytecode Block trackers patch so you can pick either or both.

patches.name: Bypass device validation
patches.description: Neutralizes the client-side device-validation gate (anti-root / anti-emulator / anti-Frida / anti-Xposed / anti-tamper battery) that shows a "Device validation failed" toast and kills the app via finishAffinity() on a rooted, emulated or re-signed build. Redirects the single failure callback to the success path so all ~16 checks report as passed and the app keeps running pre- and post-login.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes every Google Ad Manager ad (banners + interstitials) across Daily Rewards, Home, Test Your Skills and Explore by nulling the remote ad-config chokepoint, so each surface renders its no-ads layout and never requests an interstitial.

patches.name: Remove ads & tracking
patches.description: Removes every ad (AdMob) and every tracker (Firebase Analytics, AppsFlyer, Facebook, TikTok, and the Veridium SDK's own Google Analytics) — event sends, full SDK init (AppsFlyer init, TikTok initializeSdk/startTrack, MobileAds.initialize), and auto-collection. Pushwoosh push is left intact. The app then phones home only to its own Zong API.

patches.name: Unlock daily reward (skip ad)
patches.description: Claim MyZong's daily reward with no 'watch ad' popup and no ad. Forces the reward-bubble tap to take the app's own direct-claim branch (the same claim call the post-ad path makes), upstream of both the popup and the rewarded ad.

patches.name: Bypass Play license check (NetMonster)
patches.description: Removes Google Play's PairIP license check so a re-signed NetMonster 5.0.x build runs instead of being blocked by the "Get this app from Play" screen. Without it, patched 5.0.0 / 5.0.1 open the Play Store on launch and close. No effect on 4.0.4, which has no such check.

patches.name: Google Maps API key (NetMonster)
patches.description: Optional: write YOUR OWN Google Maps API key so the map renders after re-signing (NetMonster's built-in key is cert-locked). Leave the key empty to leave the map as-is.

options.description: Your own unrestricted 'Maps SDK for Android' key (Google Cloud Console). NetMonster's built-in key is locked to their signing cert and dies on re-sign (blank map). Leave empty to keep the map disabled.

patches.name: Unlock premium (NetMonster)
patches.description: Unlocks NetMonster Premium — forces the Adapty entitlement collector to always report premium active, so real-time LTE/NR-NSA location calculation is unlocked, ads are removed, and the status shows Active without a subscription.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes inDrive's Google ads — the banner, the card shown during and after a ride, and the full-screen ones — by switching the app's own Google Ads enable flags off, so it never asks Google for an ad. Rides, chat, payments and inDrive's own promo codes keep working.
